caption: The drawing depicts three main objects arranged on a plain, light beige background. On the upper left side is an L-shaped wooden structure with a diagonal support brace and a looped rope hanging from the horizontal beam; the wood is light brown with visible grain and metal fasteners at the joints. Below and slightly to the right is an open, wooden coffin with a hexagonal shape, constructed from light brown wood, with visible plank edges, metal reinforcement at the corners, and a circular metal ring at one end near the base. To the far right of the coffin, there is a rough wooden stake or club, vertically oriented, showing irregular shape and natural texture, with a medium brown color and darker streaks. The three objects are spaced apart with no overlapping, and the artist’s signature “George J. File” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Stage Props for "Punch"
